name: run_sql
description: Execute a raw SQL SELECT against the DuckDB warehouse and return matching rows. Full DuckDB SQL is supported: joins, CTEs, window functions, regex, unnest, etc. The agent is expected to issue read-only queries; writes are owned by the refresh CLI and action tools. Available tables include latest_indicators, indicator_history, bars_daily, sector_index, positions, account_summary, screens.

query.description: Full SQL statement. Example: SELECT i.symbol, i.close, i.rsi_14, i.pivot_r1 FROM latest_indicators i WHERE i.rsi_14 > 70 AND i.close BETWEEN i.pivot_r1 * 0.99 AND i.pivot_r1 * 1.01 ORDER BY i.rsi_14 DESC LIMIT 25
